description: Hands-on prompt cards for Antarious AI · PKSF workshop. Pair with facilitator FAQ.

difficulty.medium: Change one variable (region, quarter, PO code).

programme_intelligence.label: 01 · Programme Intelligence
programme_intelligence.easy: Summarise partner organisation activity in Khulna region for Q1 2026. Which three KPIs should leadership watch first?
programme_intelligence.medium: Compare Khulna vs Rajshahi on PDO disbursement pace for Q1 2026. Flag any PO more than one standard deviation below its regional mean.

me_report.label: 02 · M&E Report Generator
me_report.easy: Draft the quarterly PDO progress narrative for Q1 2026 using approved indicators. Keep tone suitable for an internal management memo.
me_report.medium: Generate the M&E section for Q1 2026 but emphasise environmental shocks (flooding) where field notes mention income disruption.

po_performance.label: 03 · PO Performance Monitor
po_performance.easy: List partner organisations in Khulna with repayment performance below the regional baseline for Q1 2026.
po_performance.medium: For PO-KHL-04, summarise trend vs prior quarter and list top two risk drivers from available data.

field_data.label: 04 · Field Data Analyst
field_data.easy: Pull themes from recent field officer logs for flagged POs in Khulna.
field_data.medium: Cross-reference field narratives with portfolio stress scores for the same POs.

beneficiary_analytics.label: 05 · Beneficiary Analytics
beneficiary_analytics.easy: Describe beneficiary outreach coverage for Q1 2026 in the selected region.
beneficiary_analytics.medium: Identify borrower cohorts with temporary income disruption mentioned in field data.

loan_portfolio.label: 06 · Loan Portfolio Monitor
loan_portfolio.easy: Show PAR-30 and on-time repayment vs regional baseline for Khulna Q1 2026.
loan_portfolio.medium: Flag portfolios with combined PAR-30 above 6% and declining recovery over two quarters.

document_drafting.label: 07 · Document Drafting
document_drafting.easy: Draft a one-page talking brief for leadership on Khulna Q1 highlights and two risks.
document_drafting.medium: Produce a board-style briefing with sections: Executive summary, Findings, Root causes, Recommendations.

compliance.label: 08 · Compliance & Risk Sentinel
compliance.easy: List any compliance flags raised on tranche disbursements for Khulna POs in Q1 2026.
compliance.medium: Explain why confidence 0.62 on a disbursement flag would escalate to a human rather than auto-resolve.

forecasting.label: 09 · Programme Forecasting
forecasting.easy: Give a baseline outlook for Khulna repayments in Q2 assuming no new shocks.
forecasting.medium: Model a stress scenario: repeat flooding — outline impact on portfolio KPIs you would monitor.

me.label: M&E / PDO leads
me.challenge_prompt: Generate one quarterly narrative paragraph you could actually paste into a donor report after human edit.

po_oversight.label: PO oversight
po_oversight.challenge_prompt: Name one lagging PO and the evidence chain from data → field note → recommended action.
po_oversight.free_exploration: PO Performance Monitor + Field Data Analyst

compliance.label: Compliance / risk
compliance.challenge_prompt: Walk through one escalation: what the agent found, confidence score, and what a human must verify.

leadership.label: Leadership / donor comms
leadership.challenge_prompt: Produce a one-page brief that balances operational truth with appropriate tone for board or donor audience.
